# A receivable kept to the tenth, and an invoice that totals a whole number of
# those tenths: 30.10 posts exactly, so nothing is rounded anywhere. A 30.00
# cash payment leaves 0.10 owed — one whole unit of this account — and a credit
# takes it.
#
# The account's unit is not the objection; a total landing between two of them
# is, and that is refused at posting rather than rounded into one.
invoice "INV-LAST-UNIT"
	customer_id: "C-COARSE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30.10
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-LAST-UNIT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-05
		amount: 30.00
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Nearly all of it, in cash"
	payment:
		amount: 50.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-01-10
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
